title: Shree Cement to cross 100 MT capacity in 3-4 yrs, targets 9-10% growth
description:
Shree Cement, the country's third-largest cement maker by installed capacity, is expecting to cross the 100 million tonnes per annum (MTPA) production capacity over the next three to four years, driven by an aggressive expansion push and steady demand from the country's infrastructure and housing sectors, said its Chairman Hari Mohan Bangur.
In an interaction with PTI, Bangur said the company is targeting a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 9-10 per cent over the next six to seven years, higher than the expected 7-8 per cent growth in the overall Indian cement industry.
Shree Cement Ltd (SCL), which earlier this month announced a Rs 7,000 crore investment to set up cement plants in Andhra Pradesh as part of its expansion, expects to reach 80 MTPA capacity in the next two years, he said.
In response to a question on whether Shree Cement would cross 100 MTPA, Bangur told PTI: "Yes, in the next 3-4 years."
SCL is having a combined investment of nearly Rs 3,500 crore to Rs 4,000 cr
